title: Frozen validation protocol
description: One record per validation protocol: the decision taken BEFORE a study ran, including the tolerance that decides its outcome. A study manifest under validation/cross-implementation/studies/ points at one of these through protocolRef and carries the record's digest, so a tolerance loosened after a result appears stops matching and the diff says 'the frozen protocol changed' rather than 'one number moved'. Validated by scripts/verify-cross-implementation-study.mjs. Writing a protocol moves no claim's evidence level; promotion is a separate, human act recorded in docs/validation/claim-register.yaml.

protocolId.description: Stable identity, and the file's basename before .protocol.json. An example protocol must be prefixed EXAMPLE- and carry example: true.

example.description: True only for a template protocol, which may only be referenced by an example manifest.

question.description: What the study is trying to find out, in one sentence, written before it ran.

frozenOn.description: The date the decision below was fixed. For a protocol transcribed from an earlier freeze, this is the date of that earlier freeze, not the date this file was written.

recordWrittenOn.description: The date this file was written. When it is later than frozenOn, the record is a transcription and freezeWitness must say where the original freeze can be read.

freezeWitness.description: Where a reader can check that the tolerance predates the result, independently of this file. A file plus the commit that introduced it, not a promise.

claims.description: One entry per claim this protocol governs. A study manifest's claimId must appear here, and its metrics must equal the entry's metrics exactly.

decisionRule.description: What outcome follows from what measurement, decided in advance. Written so that a reader can apply it to the numbers without consulting the author.

digest.description: sha256 over the canonical form of every field of this record except this one. The verifier recomputes it, and a study manifest repeats it in protocolRef.digest.

datasetIds.description: The registered datasets this protocol admits for the claim. A study manifest may not use a dataset outside this list.

parameterSetIds.description: The parameter sets this protocol admits for the claim. A study manifest may not use a parameter set outside this list.

toleranceDerivation.description: Where the tolerance came from. 'It is what the comparison happened to reach' is not a derivation.

metrics.description: The agreement gate. Same shape as a study manifest's metrics block, and a manifest that points here must match it field for field.
